prompt: I watched the new winter detective film with high hopes. Sadly, the plot is not (clever) the first part, and the big twist works (badly) than before. The studio spent twice (much) money on this film as on the first one, but it uses the exact same clues. Save your ticket money for a better night out.
explanation_ru: После отрицания is not нужна конструкция as clever as, наречие badly имеет неправильную форму worse, а после twice с неисчисляемым money ставится as much.

prompt: Dagmar wants to walk through the art gallery at her own slow pace, so she prefers the audio guide to the fast group tour. Which sentence matches her choice?
options: The group tour moves too fast, so the audio guide is much more relaxing for me.
The audio guide is faster than the group tour, so I can finish sooner.
The group tour is much slower and calmer than the audio guide.
Both tours take the same time and move at the same speed.
explanation_ru: Групповая экскурсия слишком быстрая, поэтому для неспешного осмотра аудиогид подходит гораздо лучше (much more relaxing).

prompt: These two metal chairs look the same like that famous grey statue!
answer: These two metal chairs look the same as that famous grey statue!
accepted_answers: These two metal chairs look the same as that famous grey statue!
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — употреблять like после the same; в английском всегда используется the same as.

prompt: Weekend art classes at the seaside studio have changed noticeably. New students choose bright blue and orange paints (often) than dark browns, and their pictures look (far / bright) than in past years. Among all our colours, bright sea blue has become (popular) choice in the whole studio. Mireia has already ordered extra tubes for the summer.
explanation_ru: Сравнение частотности передаётся через more often, усилитель far стоит перед brighter, а среди всех цветов (among all) требуется превосходная степень the most popular.

prompt: When you press the ink roller more lightly, the painted lines look sharper. → The more lightly …
answer: The more lightly you press the ink roller, the sharper the painted lines look.
accepted_answers: The more lightly you press the ink roller, the sharper the painted lines look.
explanation_ru: Для прямой зависимости используется парная конструкция the + сравнительная степень в начале каждой части предложения.

prompt: Heavy rain started outside the museum! We have (few) free coat hooks than usual, and visitors are coming in (fast) than I can hang their coats. There is no space left by the door. Can you bring another coat stand?
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным hooks используется fewer, а короткое наречие fast в сравнительной степени принимает форму faster.

prompt: "Which project should we take to Friday's school fair, Mathilde?" "Your wind lamp works (well) indoors than my sun clock. It also looks (interesting) when the light turns on. Let's bring the lamp."
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два проекта: наречие well образует неправильную форму better, а длинное прилагательное interesting — more interesting.

prompt: Tania noted in her autumn report that the compact solar wind meters send far steadier storm readings than the heavy older poles ever did.
answer: Tania noted in her autumn report that the compact solar wind meters send far steadier storm readings than the heavy older poles ever did.
accepted_answers: Tania noted in her autumn report that the compact solar wind meters send far steadier storm readings than the heavy older poles ever did.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: усилитель far правильно сочетается со сравнительной степенью steadier, а придаточное сравнения than… ever did построено верно.

prompt: The more clay weights you put on the boat, ___ it sits.
options: the lower
lower
the most low
more lower
explanation_ru: В конструкции the…, the… во второй части обязательно нужен артикль the перед сравнительной степенью: the lower; частая ошибка — пропустить the или добавить more.

prompt: Dear Council Members, I am writing on behalf of our local stargazing club. Because of the bright new warehouse lamps, the sky is not nearly (dark) it was five years ago, and we get (far / few) clear nights for watching stars. Our town used to be one of (good) places in the region for night-sky study. Please consider fitting shaded covers on those outdoor lights.
explanation_ru: После not nearly требуется as dark as, перед исчисляемым nights ставится усилитель с fewer (far fewer), а после one of — превосходная степень the best.

prompt: Out of all six paper wind-cars, the green one travelled the most far across the hall.
answer: Out of all six paper wind-cars, the green one travelled the furthest across the hall.
accepted_answers: Out of all six paper wind-cars, the green one travelled the furthest across the hall.
Out of all six paper wind-cars, the green one travelled the farthest across the hall.
Out of all six paper wind-cars, the green one travelled furthest across the hall.
Out of all six paper wind-cars, the green one travelled farthest across the hall.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — образовывать превосходную степень the most far; у слова far неправильная форма (the) furthest / farthest.

prompt: "How do those thin silver frames feel, Hartmut?" "They are easily (light) pair of all eight I tried on, and they cost (little) than I expected. They also fit (comfortably) than my old plastic glasses when I look down at my music. Could I buy this pair?"
explanation_ru: Усилитель easily стоит перед превосходной степенью the lightest, глагол cost требует формы less, а наречие comfortably образует сравнение через more comfortably.

prompt: The afternoon clinic slot is calmer than the early morning one. → The early morning clinic slot isn't …
answer: The early morning clinic slot isn't as calm as the afternoon one.
accepted_answers: The early morning clinic slot isn't as calm as the afternoon one.
The early morning clinic slot is not as calm as the afternoon one.
The early morning clinic slot isn't so calm as the afternoon one.
The early morning clinic slot is not so calm as the afternoon one.
The early morning clinic slot isn't as calm as the afternoon slot.
The early morning clinic slot is not as calm as the afternoon slot.
explanation_ru: Чтобы сохранить смысл при смене порядка сравнения, утвердительное calmer than заменяется на отрицательное isn't as calm as.

prompt: Cold morning swims require a proper warm-up before you jump in. The (slowly) you roll your shoulders poolside, the (smoothly) your arms move through the water during the first ten minutes. Swimmers who stretch properly also tire (little) than people who dive straight in. Give your muscles three minutes on dry land first.
explanation_ru: В парной конструкции the…, the… оба наречия на -ly требуют more (more slowly, more smoothly), а при сравнении глагола tire используется less.

prompt: People who read work messages at night get fewer sleep than others.
answer: People who read work messages at night get less sleep than others.
accepted_answers: People who read work messages at night get less sleep than others.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить fewer перед неисчисляемым существительным; со словом sleep нужно less.

prompt: Klemen laughed because the corner chemist sells that cooling gel at ___ the big shop across the street.
options: the same price like
the same price than
the same price as
equal price with
explanation_ru: С выражением the same всегда используется союз as (the same price as); варианты с like, than и equal with — частые ошибки.

prompt: Do not install this phone update on an older model! After the update, simple map apps open (much / slowly) than before, and the battery runs down (quickly) than it did. My dependable old phone is no longer (fast) it used to be. Wait until the company fixes these bugs.
explanation_ru: Усилитель much ставится перед more slowly, наречие quickly образует форму more quickly, а после отрицания no longer нужна конструкция as fast as.

prompt: Pontus needs to record interviews by a windy harbour, and the small clip-on microphone is lighter to carry and picks up far less wind noise than the heavy stand. Which sentence matches his conclusion?
options: The heavy stand is much easier to carry, though it picks up more wind noise.
The small clip-on microphone is not as light as the stand, but it sounds cleaner.
The small clip-on microphone is far easier to carry and handles the wind much better than the heavy stand.
Both microphones pick up the same amount of wind noise by the harbour.
explanation_ru: Маленький микрофон и легче носить (far easier to carry), и лучше справляется с ветром (handles the wind much better), что точно отражено в третьем варианте.

prompt: When I receive fewer chat messages in the evening, I finish my coding homework faster. → The fewer chat messages …
answer: The fewer chat messages I receive in the evening, the faster I finish my coding homework.
accepted_answers: The fewer chat messages I receive in the evening, the faster I finish my coding homework.
explanation_ru: Зависимость между двумя изменениями оформляется через The fewer…, the faster… с артиклем the в обеих частях.

prompt: "Can you actually read any of these five used e-readers outdoors?" "Let's hold them by the sunlit window. This grey screen stays (clear) of all five in bright light, and its pages turn (smoothly) than on the shiny black model. Best of all, it feels (a bit / light) than my own phone."
explanation_ru: Среди пяти устройств используется превосходная степень the clearest, при сравнении двух моделей — наречие more smoothly, а a bit смягчает сравнительную степень lighter.

prompt: The paid bus app is no better than the free one. → The free bus app is as …
answer: The free bus app is as good as the paid one.
accepted_answers: The free bus app is as good as the paid one.
The free bus app is just as good as the paid one.
The free bus app is as good as the paid bus app.
The free bus app is just as good as the paid bus app.
explanation_ru: Если платная версия не лучше бесплатной, значит, бесплатная так же хороша: as good as.

prompt: "Walking through the autumn market is exhausting, Karine — shouldn't we take the patrol car?" "Honestly, we get around the narrow lanes (easily) on foot than by car. People also stop and talk to us (often) when we walk past their stalls than when we sit in a car. On busy festival days, driving is (slow) way to cross the square."
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух способов передвижения наречия берут more easily и more often, а для самого медленного варианта в целом нужна превосходная степень the slowest.

prompt: Franz laughed because the first hiker's green umbrella was just as worn as the second one and had the same bent handle.
answer: Franz laughed because the first hiker's green umbrella was just as worn as the second one and had the same bent handle.
accepted_answers: Franz laughed because the first hiker's green umbrella was just as worn as the second one and had the same bent handle.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: конструкция равенства just as worn as и сочетание the same bent handle употреблены правильно.

prompt: "Should we book the morning castle walk or the evening lantern tour, Emrys?" "The morning walk is (quiet) than the evening tour. My parents also walk (easily) in daylight than in the dark. Let's pick the morning tickets."
explanation_ru: При выборе из двух экскурсий прилагательное quiet образует форму quieter, а наречие easily — more easily.

prompt: Alfonso warned the town council that heavy weekend tour coaches are becoming more and more louder near the old stone arches every month.
answer: Alfonso warned the town council that heavy weekend tour coaches are becoming louder and louder near the old stone arches every month.
accepted_answers: Alfonso warned the town council that heavy weekend tour coaches are becoming louder and louder near the old stone arches every month.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — смешивать more and more с коротким прилагательным на -er; правильно louder and louder.

prompt: Takeshi's archive guide reminds new volunteers that turning old pages with clean cotton gloves helps the faded ink stay clear ___ when bare hands touch the paper.
options: very longer than
by far longer as
much longer than
more longer than
explanation_ru: Для усиления сравнительной степени longer используется much (much longer than); слова very, more и связка by far…as здесь неверны.

prompt: "Look at these two paint cards by the window. Does the warm cream catch the morning light (well) than the soft green?" "Yes, and it makes our small attic look (bright) too. Let's buy the cream paint."
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два цвета: наречие well переходит в better, а короткое прилагательное bright — в brighter.

prompt: Our shiny new coffee machine roars very louder every morning than our old vacuum cleaner.
answer: Our shiny new coffee machine roars much louder every morning than our old vacuum cleaner.
accepted_answers: Our shiny new coffee machine roars much louder every morning than our old vacuum cleaner.
Our shiny new coffee machine roars far louder every morning than our old vacuum cleaner.
Our shiny new coffee machine roars even louder every morning than our old vacuum cleaner.
Our shiny new coffee machine roars a lot louder every morning than our old vacuum cleaner.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить very перед сравнительной степенью; для усиления нужны much, far, even или a lot.

prompt: Daniele sat in seven armchairs across the furniture showroom before choosing one for his grandfather. The dark blue chair had (firm) cushions of all seven, so his grandfather could stand up (quickly) than from his soft old sofa. Even though it cost more than the grey models, it was easily (useful) chair in the whole shop. Daniele ordered it for Friday delivery.
explanation_ru: Среди семи кресел нужна превосходная степень the firmest, наречие quickly образует форму more quickly, а после усилителя easily идёт the most useful.

prompt: The garden cafe is far less windy than the open sandy beach. → The open sandy beach is far …
answer: The open sandy beach is far windier than the garden cafe.
accepted_answers: The open sandy beach is far windier than the garden cafe.
explanation_ru: Обратное сравнение сохраняет усилитель far и переводит двусложное прилагательное windy в форму windier.

prompt: The bakery spelt her mother's name wrong and forgot the candles, so Despina says she has never received worse service from any shop in town. Which text message matches her reaction?
options: This is one of the better bakeries in town, even though they forgot our candles.
That bakery gave us the worst service I have ever had from any shop in town!
The cake was not as bad as last year's, so I will probably order from them again.
Other shops in town have given us even worse service than this bakery did today.
explanation_ru: Фраза never received worse service передаётся превосходной степенью с Present Perfect и ever: the worst service I have ever had.

prompt: Whenever Leandro invites his friends earlier to help grill vegetables on the wooden cabin deck, their evening birthday suppers become livelier. → The earlier Leandro …
answer: The earlier Leandro invites his friends to help grill vegetables on the wooden cabin deck, the livelier their evening birthday suppers become.
accepted_answers: The earlier Leandro invites his friends to help grill vegetables on the wooden cabin deck, the livelier their evening birthday suppers become.
The earlier Leandro invites his friends to help grill vegetables on the wooden cabin deck, the more lively their evening birthday suppers become.
explanation_ru: Конструкция the…, the… ставит сравнительные степени the earlier и the livelier в начало обеих частей предложения.
